article.title: U.S. strikes Iran on eve of midterms
article.author: Editor
article.content: The military is considering using the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb, one of the largest non-nuclear weapons in the U.S. arsenal, against Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear sites, among them Pickaxe Mountain, CNN reported October 15. The post U.S. strikes Iran on eve of midterms appeared first on MR Online .
